parameters.name: User
parameters.description: The user to whom the session belongs. When the user is unknown {{empty}} string SHOULD be used. Note: This parameter was demoted to readOnly in the Device:2.17 version.

parameters.name: IPAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the remote web client, connected to the web interface.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: Port number of the remote web client, connected to the web interface.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: Indicates when the session was created.

object.description: Web server session list. Note: This parameter was demoted to readOnly in the Device:2.17 version.
